name: kuu-orchestration
description: Native-subagent delivery with Fast GPT-6 Luna medium implementation, Deep GPT-6 Sol xhigh implementation, fresh GPT-6 Sol xhigh review, and primary integration.

interface.shortDescription: Route Fast and Deep implementation through isolated review.
interface.longDescription: Kuu Orchestration keeps decomposition, routing, integration, and acceptance in the primary task. It uses native GPT-6 Luna (gpt-6-luna with medium effort) subagents for bounded Fast implementation, GPT-6 Sol (gpt-6-sol with xhigh effort) subagents for Deep implementation, and a fresh GPT-6 Sol reviewer for every review round. User-visible tasks are reserved for durable work that must outlive the parent, needs direct follow-up, owns an independent worktree, or waits on external state.
defaultPrompt: Use Kuu Orchestration to route, implement, review, integrate, and verify this software change.
